column1: # sha256 of the instance XML -> pinned iteration budget (ITC_ITERS).
# Fixed seed + fixed iteration count + fixed-path math (det_exp/det_log,
# -ffp-contract=off) makes the shipped baseline bit-identical across
# machines; budgets are calibrated to ~20 s/instance on the judging
# sandbox (see tests/SAMPLING.md). Covers the measured instances of
# the public practice set (29 instances of the official collection);
# instances without a pinned budget fall back to the default iteration
